user_query: I want to surprise my mom with a special gift. Can you find a playlist with her favorite songs? Also, get me a random fact about the number 7 to share with her. Additionally, provide me with the information about the album 'Back to Black' by Amy Winehouse.

TaskList.description: Search for a playlist containing your mom's favorite songs.
Retrieve a random interesting fact about the number 7 to share with your mom.
Get detailed information about the album 'Back to Black' by Amy Winehouse.

dependencies.note: The playlist can be used to make the gift more special, but not strictly dependent.
The album info can be added to the gift if desired.
